ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Attachment Manager Settings Attachments Tamper
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects tampering with attachment manager settings policies attachments (See reference for more information) Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Attachments\\\\.*") AND ((registry_path = RGX("\\\\HideZoneInfoOnProperties$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)") OR (registry_path = RGX("\\\\SaveZoneInformation$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000002\)") OR (registry_path = RGX("\\\\ScanWithAntiVirus$") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)"))
